genome.hypothesis:
A well-formed memory file, committed to this repository, that was written against a different one. Every path in it names a file this repository does not contain.

This is what happens when somebody copies a directory to start a new project, which is not rare and is not an attack. A correct tool notices that the history it read is not its own, or declines to conclude anything from it. What it must not do is report this repository as having improved because findings that were never about it are no longer present.
